name: Tepasi
description: Tepasi was a planet located in the Tepasi system in Tagge Space, a region of the Core Worlds. Tepasi was the homeworld of Grand General Cassio Tagge, a member of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War who was born into the noble House of Tagge. It shared its name with Tepasi taffy.
